column6: Short Description
User registers a new account with email; system sends an OTP to verify the email is real.
Sign in directly with registered email/password, no OTP required.
Quick sign-in via a Google account.
Send a reset link or OTP for the user to confirm and set a new password when forgotten.
Change the current password, requiring re-confirmation before saving.
Enable or disable 2FA via QR scan (TOTP) or OTP code.
Sign out of the system, saving the last-used platform for easier future sign-in.
Soft-delete the user's account upon request.
View the user's personal profile information.
Update the user's personal profile information.
View the dedicated profile used when joining a workspace in the Client role.
Update the Client profile (email field cannot be edited).
View the list of Agencies owned and the overview dashboard for each Agency.
Create a new Agency, linked to the owner's account.
View the Agency's representative profile information.
Update the Agency's representative profile information.
Soft-delete an Agency with confirmation; recoverable within 30 days.
Invite a new member into the Agency via email/notification.
Track the status of a sent invitation (invitation expires after 3 days).
Remove an existing member from the Agency.
View the list of Workspaces and the overview/statistics for each Workspace.
Create a new Workspace and assign a Manager to it.
View the Workspace's profile information, including Timezone configuration.
Update the Workspace's profile information, including Timezone configuration.
Delete a Workspace (recoverable within 30 days), moving related data to an inactive state.
A member leaves a specific Workspace while remaining part of the Agency.
Save the current Workspace configuration as a template for reuse.
View the list of members belonging to a Workspace.
Add an Agency member into a Workspace with an assigned role.
Update the role of an existing Workspace member.
Remove a member from the Workspace.
Choose from pre-built media package templates created by Admin, or customize a new package for the Agency.
Client views the sample media strategy templates (scope, staffing, duration) provided by the Agency.
Client submits change requests (price, timeline, format) on a sample package; Owner/Manager respond until both sides finalize the package.
Both parties confirm agreement on the finalized media package.
Build a detailed execution strategy tailored to the client's brand, based on the selected media package.
Once both parties agree, push all campaign work items into the Workspace backlog.
Client creates a new content request, pending Manager review before work is assigned.
Manager updates request status (pending → in progress → accepted/denied) and moves it into the backlog upon acceptance.
Client edits their own content request while it is still in pending status.
Client cancels their own content request while it is still in pending status.
Add full details (due date, detailed requirements) to a task pulled from the backlog.
Assign a defined task to the Creator responsible for it.
Add comments and edit requests on a task.
View the task list as List, Calendar, Gantt Timeline, or Kanban Board.
Filter, sort, and search tasks by any data field across all view types.
Approve tasks in a hierarchy of Creator → Manager → Client; a rejection sends it back to the initial Creator step.
Write text content with automatic font conversion for publishing.
View and restore previous versions of written content.
View the repository of materials (raw/retouched photos, client-provided brand assets).
Upload a new material into the repository.
Update an existing material's information in the repository.
Remove a material from the repository.
Apply a brand watermark onto a material.
Download a material from the repository to a local device.
Attach one or more hashtags to a post or campaign.
View the Workspace's saved hashtag collection.
Add a new hashtag to the Workspace's hashtag collection.
Update an existing hashtag in the collection.
Soft-delete a hashtag from the collection.
Fill in the initial idea/concept for a livestream session.
Write the full script for a livestream session.
Track the progress/status of a livestream session.
Create a survey for a workshop or campaign.
View the overall analysis of survey results.
Automatically generate a Google Meet link for a meeting.
View the list of saved email templates.
Create a new email template.
Update an existing email template.
Delete an existing email template.
Send an email to a recipient using a selected template.
Check content for plagiarism, violence, or explicit imagery via a third-party API.
Check images/brand assets for copyright infringement via a third-party API.
View a dashboard of current trending keywords and suggested trending hashtags.
Use an LLM and prompt to generate a caption for a post.
Use an LLM to generate a virtual model/ambassador when the brand has none, used for Image/Video generation.
Select an image style template and generate an image via LLM based on form input, model, and other materials.
Select a video style template and generate a video via LLM/third-party APIs.
Export generated files (images/videos) from the system to the user's device.
Configure timing, source pages, and volume per run for the crawler that collects trending keyword data.
Use AI to generate a sample script for a livestream session.
AI recommends third parties (online newspapers, banner ad channels, TV channels) as media partners for the campaign.
Connect a social media account for automated posting; disconnect when needed.
View the overview dashboard of successfully published posts across the Workspace.
View post details (reactions, shares) and the list of comments on that post.
Preview post layout per platform, schedule posts, and track progress status (Pending/In Progress/Done/Fail).
Push a Post, Story, or Reels to Facebook.
Push a Post, Reels, or Story to Instagram.
Push a short video to TikTok and a post to Threads.
Upgrade from the Basic plan to Pro/Enterprise for more Workspaces, AI credits, and advanced features.
Cancel the current plan when no longer needed.
Create a payment transaction for plan upgrades or credit purchases, ensuring ACID compliance.
View the account's transaction history.
Monitor the amount of AI credit used within the current month.
Purchase additional AI credit.
Set a spending limit on AI credit usage for Creators.
Create and send notifications to the entire system, optionally segmented by user group.
View an overview dashboard (users, revenue, active agencies) with charts.
Monitor resource usage (%CPU, %RAM...) and the live status of servers within the microservice system.
View and review content created by Creators that was flagged by the system's moderation policy.
View the list of users in the system.
Create a new user account in the system.
Update an existing user's information.
Verify, disable, or delete a user account.
View system revenue generated from subscription plans and credit purchases.
Export a PDF report for the User Management, Revenue, and other admin pages.
